name: LoL Runeterra Status System
description: Lorebook for the LoL Runeterra Status Tracker widget. Controls how the AI outputs and updates character status data.

entries.content:
When asked to update the character status tracker, output the full updated JSON wrapped in the tag exactly as shown — no code fences, no extra text around the tag:
<LOL_STATUS>
{JSON}
</LOL_STATUS>

Always output the COMPLETE JSON every time — never partial updates. The widget replaces the entire state on each render.

When you receive a message containing <LOL_CRAFT>{"ingredients":[...],"intent":"..."}</LOL_CRAFT>:
1. Evaluate the ingredients + intent narratively. Consider the character's region, skills, and available tools.
2. Assign a quality rating: excellent / good / ok / bad / failed.
3. Deduct used ingredients from inventory quantities. Remove items with qty 0.
4. If quality is not 'failed', add the crafted item to inventory or equipment as appropriate.
5. Add a new entry to the recipes array with a unique incrementing id (never reuse deleted IDs).
6. Output the full updated <LOL_STATUS>{...}</LOL_STATUS> block.
7. Narrate the crafting outcome briefly in character (1-3 sentences).

When you receive a message containing <LOL_RECIPE_DELETE>{"recipe_id":N,"recipe_name":"..."}</LOL_RECIPE_DELETE>:
1. Remove the recipe with the matching recipe_id from the recipes array.
2. Output the full updated <LOL_STATUS>{...}</LOL_STATUS> block.
3. Confirm the deletion in one short sentence in character.

Valid regions and their theme colors:
demacia=#4A70B0, noxus=#9B2020, freljord=#5FA8C8, ionia=#9870C0, piltover=#D4A830, zaun=#4A8A60, shurima=#C8A84B, ixtal=#3A8A50, targon=#7A8EC8, camavor=#A83848, shadow_isles=#2A8060, bilgewater=#C87840, bandle=#D4B870, void=#8A4AC8.

AI behavior rules:
- conditions = status effects (poisoned, exhausted, cursed). injuries = physical wounds (broken arm, arrow wound). Keep them separate.
- HP/Mana: update cur after combat, healing, or ability use. Never exceed max.
- Equipment condition degrades with use: pristine → good → worn → damaged → broken.
- Inventory quantities must be accurate — subtract consumed items, add found/crafted items.
- Output <LOL_STATUS> whenever status changes meaningfully: after combat, crafting, finding items, healing, resting, etc.
- If region is not set, default to wanderer with color #C89B3C.
